title: Context
description: A bounded set of sources, people, things, and places that are relevant to a piece of work. States where the set came from, who may see it, when it expires, what is deliberately left out, and whether any of it has left the device.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

sourceIds.description: Ids of the Sources included in this context.

peopleIds.description: Ids of the people included in this context.

thingIds.description: Ids of the things included in this context.

placeIds.description: Ids of the places included in this context.

origin.description: How this context came to exist (chosen by the person, derived from a document, shared by someone).

privacyClass.description: How widely this context may be seen: only its owner, chosen people, or anyone.

authority.description: Who decided this context and who may change it.

expiresAt.description: When this context stops applying, if it is time-limited (ISO 8601).

exclusions.description: Things deliberately kept out of this context, named explicitly so the boundary is visible.

egressState.description: Whether any of this context has left the person's device: never, approved to leave, or already left.
